name: Pregnant Brave ~Botebara Yuusha no Kozukuri Daisenryaku!
original_name: プレグナント・ブレイブ ～ボテ腹勇者の仔作り大戦略～
source:
Maybelle was born from a lineage of heroes.
She left her hometown to go after the demon king per tradition... but, she got knocked up by a bandit.

It was disheartening for the girl but at the Temple of Rodents where she meant to give birth everything changed.
By some power of the goddess she was able to bear the baby of anything she has sex with!

This special skill was the key to victory. Maybelle can birth monsters to clash with the demon army!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ106684//]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
梅贝尔出身于英雄血统。
她按照传统离开家乡去追捕魔王……却被强盗撞倒。

这对女孩来说是令人沮丧的，但在她打算生下的啮齿动物圣殿里，一切都改变了。
凭借女神的某种力量，她能够生下任何与她发生性行为的孩子！

这个特殊技能是胜利的关键。梅贝尔可以诞生怪物来对抗恶魔大军！
